name: ati-monorepo
description: Monorepo orquestrador do ecossistema ATI (Extensão do Chrome e Painel Web)

scripts.clean: npm run clean:extension && npm run clean:site
scripts.build:extension: npm run clean:extension && npm run build --prefix "Extensao"
scripts.build:site: npm run clean:site && npm run build --prefix "Site"
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:site
scripts.zip:extension: npm run clean:extension && npm run zip --prefix "Extensao"
scripts.release:extension: npm run clean:extension && npm run release --prefix "Extensao"

author: Vituali
